titleEn: NZ has unique stories of evolution and geology. Is it time for a natural history museum?
titleZh: 新西兰独特的演化与地质故事，是否值得一座自然史博物馆？
method: Machine reference translation with paragraph alignment; not manually certified.

paragraphs.en: Like the Galapagos Islands, New Zealand’s unique isolation makes it an iconic natural history location of global importance.
paragraphs.zh: 与加拉帕戈斯群岛一样，新西兰独特的与世隔绝的地理位置使其成为具有全球重要性的标志性自然历史地点。

paragraphs.en: Already famous for its flightless birds and their story of evolution on a mammal-free archipelago, New Zealand is home to many other, less well known but equally important plants and animals.
paragraphs.zh: 新西兰已经以其不会飞的鸟类和它们在一个没有哺乳动物的群岛上的进化故事而闻名，新西兰是许多其他不太知名但同样重要的植物和动物的家园。

paragraphs.en: This includes horopito, which has the most primitive flower of any plant alive today, or the hihi/stitchbird, which is the only member of an entire avian family.
paragraphs.zh: 这包括horopito，它拥有当今所有植物中最原始的花朵，或者hihi/hiichbird，这是整个鸟类家族的唯一成员。

paragraphs.en: I often wonder why New Zealand doesn’t have a dedicated natural history museum (like those in London, Paris, Vienna or New York) to celebrate its unique biodiversity, geology and fossil record.
paragraphs.zh: 我经常想知道为什么新西兰没有一个专门的自然历史博物馆（像伦敦，巴黎，维也纳或纽约那样）来庆祝其独特的生物多样性，地质和化石记录。

paragraphs.en: With ongoing changes in leadership at the Museum of New Zealand Te Papa Tongarewa, it might be time to have this conversation.
paragraphs.zh: 随着新西兰Te Papa Tongarewa博物馆领导层的不断变化，可能是时候进行这次对话了。

paragraphs.en: The case for a natural history museum
paragraphs.zh: 自然历史博物馆的案例

paragraphs.en: The research of natural history scientists at Te Papa is world class. But in terms of public-facing displays, the museum cannot do New Zealand’s geological and biological heritage justice.
paragraphs.zh: 蒂帕帕博物馆的自然历史科学家的研究是世界级的。但就面向公众的展示而言，博物馆无法公正地展示新西兰的地质和生物遗产。

paragraphs.en: It has to be too many things to too many people, leaving too little space for natural history.
paragraphs.zh: 对太多的人来说，它必须是太多的东西，留给自然历史的空间太少。

paragraphs.en: Some treasures are currently on display, including New Zealand’s first dinosaur fossil discovered by famed palaeontologist Joan Wiffen. But this and other fossils of national and global significance remain mostly confined to a small exhibition area.
paragraphs.zh: 一些珍宝目前正在展出，包括新西兰第一个恐龙化石，由著名的古生物学家琼·威芬发现。但这和其他具有国家和全球意义的化石仍然主要局限于一个小的展览区。

paragraphs.en: Only a tiny fraction of any museum’s collections is on display. Notable examples missing from display at Te Papa include reconstructions of New Zealand’s dinosaurs and many fossils of recently discovered species such as the eight-million-year-old giant crab from Taranaki.
paragraphs.zh: 博物馆的藏品中只有一小部分在展出。值得注意的例子包括新西兰恐龙的重建和许多最近发现的物种的化石，如来自塔拉纳基的八百万年前的巨型螃蟹。

paragraphs.en: Apart from Te Papa’s collections, Wellington holds others of national importance, including of fossils, marine species and rocks at Earth Sciences New Zealand.
paragraphs.zh: 除了蒂帕帕的收藏品，惠灵顿还拥有其他具有国家重要性的收藏品，包括新西兰地球科学院的化石、海洋物种和岩石。

paragraphs.en: Around the country, other collections also exist, including of arthropods and fungi as well as the Allan Herbarium at the Bioeconomy Science Institute. The University of Otago’s geology museum is an example of a collection held by an academic institution.
paragraphs.zh: 在全国范围内，还存在其他收藏品，包括节肢动物和真菌，以及生物经济科学研究所的艾伦植物标本馆。奥塔哥大学的地质博物馆是学术机构收藏的一个例子。

paragraphs.en: But these collections aren’t protected by an act of parliament like Te Papa, and they don’t have the same level of public accessibility or funding the national museum has. I propose they should all be combined to form the basis of a new museum.
paragraphs.zh: 但这些藏品不像蒂帕帕那样受到议会法案的保护，它们也没有国家博物馆那样的公众可及性和资金。我建议把它们都结合起来，形成一个新博物馆的基础。

paragraphs.en: Current public displays on New Zealand’s biodiversity don’t always put it into a global or evolutionary context. For example, New Zealand is the cradle of penguin evolution and the ancestors of many now endemic birds came from Australia, South America, the northern hemisphere and in some cases, places unknown.
paragraphs.zh: 目前公开展示的新西兰生物多样性并不总是将其置于全球或进化的背景下。例如，新西兰是企鹅进化的摇篮，许多现在特有的鸟类的祖先来自澳大利亚，南美洲，北方，在某些情况下，未知的地方。

paragraphs.en: Biodiversity displays could be further strengthened by showcasing New Zealand’s geological heritage. Rock and mineral displays can be popular attractions and it would be a prime opportunity to put pounamu in a global context. Pounamu is the Indigenous Māori name for nephrite jade and bowenite, which is a taonga (treasure) for carving.
paragraphs.zh: 通过展示新西兰的地质遗产，可以进一步加强生物多样性的展示。岩石和矿物的展示是很受欢迎的景点，这将是一个将Pounamu放在全球范围内的绝佳机会。Pounamu是土著毛利人对软玉和bowenite的称呼，bowenite是一种雕刻珍品。

paragraphs.en: From contested to globally relevant spaces
paragraphs.zh: 从有争议的领域到全球相关领域

paragraphs.en: The Victorian concept of a museum has a colonial history. This has led to collections containing numerous contested objects such as the Parthenon marbles in the British Museum and Indigenous human remains stored in collections worldwide.
paragraphs.zh: 维多利亚时代的博物馆概念有一段殖民历史，这导致了大量有争议的藏品，如大英博物馆的帕台农神庙大理石和世界各地收藏的土著人类遗骸。

paragraphs.en: By being open about this history and working with mana whenua (local Māori groups), a new museum could help heal these rifts.
paragraphs.zh: 通过对这段历史的开放，并与当地毛利人团体合作，一个新的博物馆可以帮助弥合这些裂痕。

paragraphs.en: This would enable exhibitions with a global focus, for example about the evolution of life on Earth, to be told through the fossil record and living biodiversity.
paragraphs.zh: 这将使具有全球焦点的展览，例如关于地球上生命的进化，通过化石记录和生物多样性来讲述。

paragraphs.en: A prime example is the fossil of one of the first dinosaurs ever described (Iguanodon), held by Te Papa, which helped start the world’s ongoing interest in dinosaurs.
paragraphs.zh: 一个最好的例子是有史以来最早描述的恐龙之一（禽龙）的化石，由Te Papa持有，这有助于启动世界对恐龙的持续兴趣。

paragraphs.en: Currently Te Papa does not display any biodiversity from outside New Zealand. Imagine seeing a whole gallery of fossil and living whale skeletons to illustrate their remarkable evolutionary journey from land to sea, similar to displays in the gallery of palaeontology and comparative anatomy in Paris.
paragraphs.zh: 目前Te Papa没有展示任何来自新西兰以外的生物多样性。想象一下，看到一整个化石和活鲸鱼骨架画廊，以说明他们从陆地到海洋的非凡进化历程，类似于巴黎古生物学和比较解剖学画廊的展示。

paragraphs.en: Like the incredible, almost complete Triceratops skeleton Museums Victoria acquired for AU$3 million, a dedicated natural history museum in New Zealand should source specimens and loans ethically to promote collaborative research and public outreach.
paragraphs.zh: 就像维多利亚博物馆以300万澳元收购的令人难以置信的、几乎完整的三角龙骨架一样，新西兰的一个专门的自然历史博物馆应该在道德上采购标本和贷款，以促进合作研究和公共宣传。

paragraphs.en: Scientists and their research could also be showcased. This would keep the museum relevant and in the public mind. As part of its public exhibitions, the Swedish Museum of Natural History has displays of their researchers explaining the importance of their work.
paragraphs.zh: 科学家和他们的研究也可以被展示出来。这将使博物馆保持相关性并在公众心目中。作为其公共展览的一部分，瑞典自然历史博物馆展出了他们的研究人员解释他们工作的重要性。

paragraphs.en: Location, support and funding
paragraphs.zh: 地点、支助和供资

paragraphs.en: Core activities of a natural history museum include growing, caring for and researching collections as well as providing access to the public. Most of these are not financially viable.
paragraphs.zh: 自然历史博物馆的核心活动包括增加、照顾和研究藏品以及向公众提供访问机会。其中大部分在财政上是不可行的。

paragraphs.en: A natural history museum would therefore require core funding from central government to avoid closure such as what recently happened at the Philadelphia Academy of Natural Sciences.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，一个自然历史博物馆需要中央政府的核心资金，以避免关闭，如最近发生在费城自然科学院。

paragraphs.en: Public-private partnerships are a funding option but have raised ethical issues such as the London Science Museum’s past relationship with the oil company Equinor.
paragraphs.zh: 公私合作是一种融资选择，但也引发了伦理问题，比如伦敦科学博物馆过去与石油公司Equinor的关系。

paragraphs.en: A new museum may seem expensive, but it could generate significant tourism income to reinvest into curation and research. Museums in New Zealand contributed at least NZ$1.1 billion to New Zealand’s GDP in 2023.
paragraphs.zh: 新建一座博物馆看似昂贵，但它可以产生可观的旅游收入，用于再投资于策展和研究。2023年，新西兰的博物馆为新西兰的GDP贡献了至少11亿新西兰元。

paragraphs.en: High-quality international touring exhibitions, such as Te Papa’s successful Whales Tohora, could further showcase the global importance of New Zealand’s biological heritage.
paragraphs.zh: 高质量的国际巡回展览，如Te Papa成功举办的鲸鱼Tohora，可以进一步展示新西兰生物遗产的全球重要性。

paragraphs.en: Gareth Nelson, who was the curator of fishes at the American Museum of Natural History before retiring to Australia to work on plant taxonomy, once famously said:
paragraphs.zh: 加雷思纳尔逊曾是美国自然历史博物馆的鱼类馆长，后来退休到澳大利亚从事植物分类学工作，他曾有一句名言：

paragraphs.en: Explain New Zealand and the world falls into place around it.
paragraphs.zh: 解释新西兰和世界福尔斯落入它周围的地方。

paragraphs.en: This could be the guiding principle for a new museum dedicated to New Zealand’s biological heritage.
paragraphs.zh: 这可以成为专门介绍新西兰生物遗产的新博物馆的指导原则。
